answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1726 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the inlet. The trellis index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the comet queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. A 107 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
